final: WITH per_txn AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS overall_avg FROM per_txn), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anly FROM per_txn p, overall o WHERE p.avg_anly > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS kavg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anly AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_anly - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall, k.avg_anly - ka.kavg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
